import sys
import math

def multiply_mod(a, b, m):
    need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
    n = 1 << (need - 1).bit_length()
    a_re = [0.0] * n
    a_im = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(a)):
        x = a[i] % m
        a_re[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        a_im[i] = x >> 15
    fft(a_re, a_im, False)
    b_re = [0.0] * n
    b_im = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(len(b)):
        x = b[i] % m
        b_re[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1)
        b_im[i] = x >> 15
    fft(b_re, b_im, False)
    a_re2 = [0.0] * n
    a_im2 = [0.0] * n
    b_re2 = [0.0] * n
    b_im2 = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
        a1r = (a_re[i] + a_re[j]) / 2
        a1i = (a_im[i] - a_im[j]) / 2
        a2r = (a_im[i] + a_im[j]) / 2
        a2i = (a_re[j] - a_re[i]) / 2
        b1r = (b_re[i] + b_re[j]) / 2
        b1i = (b_im[i] - b_im[j]) / 2
        b2r = (b_im[i] + b_im[j]) / 2
        b2i = (b_re[j] - b_re[i]) / 2
        a_re2[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        a_im2[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        b_re2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        b_im2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r
    fft(a_re2, a_im2, True)
    fft(b_re2, b_im2, True)
    res = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        aa = round(a_re2[i])
        bb = round(b_re2[i])
        cc = round(a_im2[i])
        res[i] = int((aa + (bb << 15) + (cc << 30)) % m)
    return res

def fft(re, im, inverse):
    n = len(re)
    shift = 32 - (n.bit_length() - 1)
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int('{:b}'.format(i << shift)[::-1], 2)
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]

                k = j * w_idx
                wRe = csi[k] if not inverse else cs[k]
                wIm = sni[k] if not inverse else sn[k]
                uRe = re[i + j]
                uIm = im[i + j]
                vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm
                vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe
                re[i + j] = uRe + vRe
                im[i + j] = uIm + vIm

                im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm
        length <<= 1

def generate_roots(n):
